title: Vegan Blackberry Galette
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegan dessert featuring a flaky crust and a sweet blackberry filling.

ingredients.name: flaxseed meal
ingredients.notes: mixed with 3 tbsp water to replace egg

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine almond flour, coconut oil, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Mix in flaxseed meal mixture and nutmeg.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer dough to a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Arrange blackberries on one half of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the blackberries, pressing edges to seal.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
